scripts.build:presentation: npm run img:mermaid && npm run pdf:presentation
scripts.pdf:pandoc: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data pandoc/latex:3.1.13 pandoc docs/presentation/presentation-fr.md -o docs/presentation/presentation-fr.pdf --from markdown --pdf-engine=xelatex --resource-path=.:docs/presentation/images
scripts.pptx:pandoc: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data pandoc/core:3.1.13 pandoc docs/presentation/presentation-fr.md -o docs/presentation/presentation-fr.pptx --from markdown --resource-path=.:docs/presentation/images
scripts.build:presentation:docker: npm run img:mermaid:docker && npm run pdf:pandoc
